en_title: The Elder Scrolls VI: Sentinel Finally Got Its Name Today, but Bethesda Says It Will Be 'Some Time Before We’re Ready to Share More'
cn_title: 《上古卷轴6：Sentinel》今天终于公布名称，但贝塞斯达表示「还需要一段时间才能准备好分享更多内容」
opus_summary: 贝塞斯达公布了《上古卷轴6：Sentinel》的名称和地点，并表示还需一段时间才会分享更多消息。彭博社记者Jason Schreier称，游戏距离发售仍有两年以上。贝塞斯达和XBOX CEO Asha Sharma此前确认，游戏已处于可玩状态。

paragraphs.en: Bethesda finally revealed the name for The Elder Scrolls VI: Sentinel, more than eight years after teasing it at E3 2018 , but we'll reportedly have to wait at least two more years before it comes out.
paragraphs.cn: 在2018年E3上预告《上古卷轴6：Sentinel》八年多后，贝塞斯达终于公布了游戏名称，但据报道，我们至少还要再等两年才能等到它发售。

paragraphs.en: After releasing its 'Official Name Reveal' trailer for The Elder Scrolls VI: Sentinel, Bethesda posted on X / Twitter to say that "Development continues, and while it’ll be some time before we’re ready to share more, it feels great to finally reveal the name and location with you."
paragraphs.cn: 发布《上古卷轴6：Sentinel》的「官方名称公布」预告片后，贝塞斯达在X上发文表示：「开发工作仍在继续，虽然还需要一段时间才能准备好分享更多内容，但终于能向大家公布名称和地点，感觉很棒。」

paragraphs.en: So, if you were hoping that Bethesda breaking its silence was a sign that the game was coming out any time soon, well, you're going to have to wait a bit longer.
paragraphs.cn: 所以，如果你原本希望贝塞斯达打破沉默是游戏即将发售的迹象，那么，你还得再等一段时间。

paragraphs.en: What's taking so long? Perhaps the better question is, why did Bethesda announced The Elder Scrolls 6 so early? Bloomberg's Jason Schreier posted on Bluesky to say that when Bethesda teased The Elder Scrolls 6 back in 2018, it was to "to soften the blow of Fallout 76," rather than to suggest it was anywhere close to release. The multiplayer-focused Fallout 76 was panned by critics at launch, with most Bethesda fans expressing their dismay that the studio had veered away from its single-player roots. Schreier followed up to say that The Elder Scrolls 6 is "still more than two years away!"
paragraphs.cn: 为什么要花这么久？或许更好的问题是，贝塞斯达为什么这么早就公布《上古卷轴6》？彭博社的Jason Schreier在Bluesky发文表示，贝塞斯达早在2018年预告《上古卷轴6》，是为了「缓和《辐射76》带来的冲击」，而不是暗示游戏离发售已经不远。主打多人的《辐射76》在发售时遭到评论界批评，大多数贝塞斯达粉丝也对工作室偏离其单人游戏根基表示失望。Schreier随后补充说，《上古卷轴6》「距离发售还有两年多！」

paragraphs.en: However, both Bethesda and Xbox CEO Asha Sharma have confirmed The Elder Scrolls 6 is in a playable state. In August, Sharma tweeted that she was getting a live playthrough of the game, while also teasing the subtitle with a lot of asterisks, which sent Elder Scrolls fans into a frenzy trying to figure out what the game would be called.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，贝塞斯达和XBOX首席执行官Asha Sharma都已确认，《上古卷轴6》目前已处于可玩状态。8月，Sharma发推称，她正在观看游戏的现场游玩演示，同时还用大量星号预告了副标题，这让《上古卷轴》粉丝疯狂猜测游戏的名称。
